title: Create:  Oliver
description: Some Create Mods and QOL Features including Create Aeronautics!
body:
Dive into the world of Create and its best add-ons, including Create Aeronautics!
Build incredible machines, automate everything, and explore endless possibilities.

Fight powerful bosses, upgrade your gear, and take your adventure beyond Earth — all the way to Mars!
From massive factories to flying airships, this modpack combines technology, exploration, and epic battles for the ultimate Create experience.
